criteria.criterion: Answer the requested facets using the captured evidence; distinguish unsupported or unavailable facts.
Support material claims with the recorded successful sources; do not invent source paths or citations.
State relevant version, configuration and uncertainty boundaries without converting missing evidence into a guarantee.
Give a coherent actionable answer or comparison rather than a union of duplicated source summaries.
